content.user_title: Coordinate Data Pipelines and Quality Checks
content.value_statement: Data pipeline work can become inconsistent when ingestion, features, quality, and reporting are planned separately. This skill organizes data tasks around pipeline context, quality gates, lineage, and handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Defines context for pipelines, features, standards, and test requirements.
Coordinates ETL, feature engineering, analytics, quality, and pipeline skills.
Lists data task steps from source review through result validation.
Applies checklists for pipeline reliability, quality, feature work, and testing.
Documents event examples for data source updates and pipeline completion.
limitations: It provides orchestration guidance, not runnable pipeline code.
It does not connect to databases, storage systems, or external services.
It requires project-specific standards and schemas to produce detailed decisions.
It cannot verify real data quality without access to datasets and tests.

use_cases.title: Plan Reliable ETL Work
use_cases.description: Define sources, dependencies, validation, recovery, and monitoring before building a data pipeline.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Reporting Changes
use_cases.description: Align metrics, feature definitions, dashboard freshness, and documentation before releasing analytics updates.

use_cases.title: Prepare Feature Workflows
use_cases.description: Plan dependencies, versioning, edge cases, monitoring, and quality checks for model inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Data Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an ETL task for [source] to [destination]. Include sources, dependencies, validation checks, quality gates, and documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Feature Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed feature workflow: [details]. Identify dependencies, lineage needs, quality tests, monitoring, and team handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Orchestration Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an orchestration plan for a batch and stream workflow with [SLA]. Include context, assignments, tests, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Data Program Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit our data program using this guidance. Compare pipelines, features, governance, quality checks, events, and anti-patterns. Return prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Plan a daily aggregation pipeline for transactions and customer records.
output_examples.output: The plan identifies source dependencies, validation rules, recovery checkpoints, data quality gates, lineage updates, and documentation changes.

output_examples.input: Review a churn risk feature before release.
output: Confirm source dependencies and business logic ownership.
Add completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and validity checks.
Define monitoring for feature drift, freshness, and downstream model impact.

output_examples.input: Coordinate a pipeline completion event with analytics and backend teams.
output_examples.output: The output explains expected handoffs, reporting updates, API contract checks, cache considerations, and quality score review.

best_practices: Validate inputs, transformations, and outputs before marking a data task complete.
Track lineage, ownership, and documentation for every pipeline and feature change.
Set measurable quality gates before downstream teams consume data.
anti_patterns: Skipping validation because a pipeline completed successfully.
Creating feature logic without documenting dependencies and business rules.
Treating monitoring and recovery as optional follow-up work.

faq.question: Does this skill run pipeline code?
faq.answer: No. It provides orchestration guidance and examples. It does not include runnable scripts or integrations.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What data work does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers ETL, analytics coordination, feature engineering, quality checks, lineage, monitoring, and documentation handoffs.

faq.question: Does it replace data quality tests?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan required tests, but real quality checks must run against your datasets.

faq.question: Is it useful for governance reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for schema management, lineage tracking, privacy compliance, and access control planning.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide source systems, destination targets, data contracts, quality standards, SLAs, and downstream consumers.
